policy: V3 does not rewrite V2. It records supersession and new schema authorities as an additive overlay. Base-registry entries not named here retain their V2 meaning.

supersessions.reason: V2 binds exact funding source, destination, payment idempotency key, purpose and approver-policy digest.
V2 requires destination-bound capital.authorization/v2 in the authorization phase.

additions.authority_note: Human/multisig capital decision only. Exact payer, payee, asset, amount, idempotency key and purpose are bound. AI cannot authorize and payment execution remains MetaPay-owned.
Provenance-only nine-phase causal trace using capital.authorization/v2. It cannot execute transactions or recognize profit.
